text: Russia has likely sustained approximately 138,000 casualties (killed and wounded in the Russia-Ukraine conflict so far in 2025 The rise in casualty rates has continued into early April 2025, and is highly likely reflective of increased Russian attacks along the frontline Russian forces are likely attempting to rebuild frontline momentum following a period of lower attacks in the opening months of the year Since invading Ukraine, Russia has likely sustained more than 920,000 total casualties
